title: Learn the Tap Shim Sham (How to)

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher provides clear, structured breakdowns of tap steps with verbal counts and physical demonstrations. She emphasizes proper technique and rhythmic accuracy while gradually building up routines.

lesson_structure.note: Historical background on the Shim Sham Shimmy
Breakdown of the first step stomp spank step
Breakdown of section two push / stomp heel stomp heel

cues: Step toe step hop step hop out in
common_mistakes: Doing a big full foot instead of a stomp
Falling into the wrong rhythm on the break

steps_taught.name: Stomp Spank Step
steps_taught.description: Stomp, spank, and step starting on count four.

steps_taught.name: Break
steps_taught.description: Step toe step hop step hop out and in.

steps_taught.name: Push / Stomp Heel Stomp Heel
steps_taught.description: Stomp heel stomp heel alternating feet.

what_works: Clear counting and repetition of each step
Demonstrating both right and left sides separately
what_hinders: Camera angle faces away from the mirror, showing only the back of the teacher

quotes.text: So from the top, we're going to start with stomp spank step.
And this break you will see multiple times throughout the piece.
There are multiple versions of the Shim Sham in the world.
